title: Neon Pulse — Episode 2: The Hidden Signal
description: Kael tracks the electrical pulse to an abandoned industrial facility, but realizes he is being led into a trap by the very organization hunting him.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The signal isn't random. It’s a rhythmic hum, guiding me deep into this derelict factory. Every step feels like walking into a snare.
scenes.visual: walking through a dusty, dark warehouse floor with rusted metal beams and scattered debris in shadows

scenes.narration: My jacket’s amber patterns are reacting. They pulse faster the closer I get to the core of this place.
scenes.visual: glowing amber light illuminating dark interior space while hand reaches out to touch a cold metal wall

scenes.narration: I thought I was hunting the truth. I was wrong. The energy here is feeding on me.
scenes.visual: stumbling back as sparks fly from loose wires dangling from a high ceiling in a dim room

scenes.narration: Suddenly, the silence breaks. A low-frequency whine echoes through the hall, and the doors behind me lock tight.
scenes.visual: heavy steel door slamming shut and locking as dust falls from the overhead rafters

scenes.narration: My internal rhythm hitches. They aren't just watching; they are trying to calibrate me like a piece of equipment.
scenes.visual: clutching head in pain while blue and amber light flickers uncontrollably around the silhouette

scenes.narration: I reach deep into the static. If they want this power, they are going to get more than they bargained for.
scenes.visual: arcing electricity snapping from fingertips toward a metal control console creating intense bright sparks

scenes.narration: The wall crumbles under the discharge. I see them now, standing in the shadows across the courtyard.
scenes.visual: looking out through a jagged hole in a concrete wall toward dark figures silhouetted in the distance

scenes.narration: There is no turning back now. This war has just begun. Follow along for more of my story.
scenes.visual: running toward a distant exit with intense determination on face while debris falls around
